manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up red block, set it on the left. Then grab green block, position it next to red block. Finally, place blue block to the right of green block.

Task description: The objects are three separate solid-colored small blocks on the table: blue currently on the left, red just left of center, and green on the right. Arrange them in an adjacent row in red, green, blue order from left to right in the head-camera view.

Success criteria: The red block center must be left of the green center, and the green center left of the blue center. Red/green and green/blue pairs must be close, with little front-to-back center offset. All blocks must rest on the table, released by both open grippers.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above and, following the block's current orientation, grip the middle of two opposite faces. Open slightly wider than the block in that direction. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides to avoid gripping only corners or pushing the block away.
- During approach or transport, use the open area in front of the central white cardboard box, leaving clearance for both the gripper and block to pass without brushing the box or blocks already placed.
- When placing beside neighboring blocks, leave room to withdraw the fingers. Release only after the bottom is supported by the table, then withdraw upward to avoid moving or pushing the neighboring block out of place.
